entertainment.location_base: Qianmen West Street, Zhengyang Market Building 3, Xicheng District, Beijing
entertainment.location_local: 北京市西城区前门西大街正阳市场3号楼
entertainment.type_local: 传统茶馆 / 演艺表演
entertainment.note_base: Evening show tickets ~130-180 CNY; includes tea and light snacks. Book online in advance.
entertainment.note_local: 晚场票约130-180元，含茶水和小吃，建议提前网上购票
entertainment.notes_base: Laoshe Teahouse (老舍茶馆), named after Beijing playwright Lao She, is one of Beijing's most iconic cultural venues — located at Qianmen, 5 minutes from Dashilar. The evening folk art show runs ~90 min and features Beijing opera (京剧) face-painting, acrobatics, cross-talk comedy (相声), and traditional music. A perfect introduction to Beijing culture on the first night. The teahouse atmosphere is warm and relaxed — no dress code, all ages welcome. Ideal for an arrival evening: not too late, culturally rich, and right in the area you will already be exploring. Optional — skip to save 150 CNY/person. Free alternative: continue evening hutong stroll at Yangmeizhu Xiejie.
entertainment.notes_local: 老舍茶馆以北京著名剧作家老舍命名，是北京最具代表性的文化场所之一，紧邻前门，距大栅栏步行5分钟。晚场民间艺术演出约90分钟，包含京剧脸谱展示、杂技、相声和传统音乐。是抵京第一晚了解北京文化的绝佳选择。茶馆氛围温馨轻松，无着装要求，老少皆宜。演出不太晚，文化体验丰富，正好在当天已探索的区域内。可选项目——若想节省150元/人可跳过，免费替代方案：继续在杨梅竹斜街夜游胡同。

entertainment.name_base: TIAO Hutong Bar at Mandarin Oriental (十条 TIAO)
entertainment.location_base: No. 40 Xixinglong Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing (inside Mandarin Oriental Qianmen)
entertainment.location_local: 北京市东城区西兴隆街40号（北京前门文华东方酒店内）
entertainment.type_local: 胡同鸡尾酒吧 / 露台酒吧
entertainment.note_base: Signature cocktails ~168 CNY each; walk-in only. Arrive before 19:30 to avoid queues. Smart casual dress.
entertainment.note_local: 招牌鸡尾酒约168元，接受散客，建议19:30前到以免排队，着装休闲商务
entertainment.notes_base: TIAO (十条) is a sophisticated hutong cocktail bar hidden inside the Mandarin Oriental Qianmen hotel, situated on Caochang Shitiao hutong (草厂十条胡同). Named after its alley, TIAO offers two floors and an open terrace. Signature cocktails are hutong-themed: the 'Caochang Hutong' (草厂胡同) cocktail uses Sichuan peppercorn and arrives in a green gourd bottle — a viral hit on Xiaohongshu. Best seats are at the front bar or 2nd floor terrace in good weather. Ideal as a light first-evening option after exploring Qianmen and Dashilar — the hutong location adds authenticity without being touristy. Use as an alternative if the teahouse show is sold out or if a more relaxed atmosphere is preferred.
entertainment.notes_local: 十条TIAO是隐匿于北京前门文华东方酒店、坐落在草厂十条胡同内的精致鸡尾酒吧。招牌酒单以胡同为主题：草厂胡同鸡尾酒使用花椒，以绿色葫芦瓶盛放，小红书爆款。一楼吧台靠窗位和天气好时二楼露台最佳。作为探索前门和大栅栏后的第一晚轻松选择非常合适，胡同位置增添真实感而不失品质。若茶馆演出已满票或偏好更轻松的氛围，可作替代选项。

entertainment.name_base: Houhai Bar Street Evening (后海酒吧街)
entertainment.location_base: Houhai Lake area, Xicheng District, Beijing
entertainment.location_local: 北京市西城区后海湖区
entertainment.note_base: Drinks from ~30-60 CNY; free to walk along the lake
entertainment.note_local: 酒水约30-60元，沿湖散步免费
entertainment.notes_base: After a tiring Great Wall day, the lakeside Houhai area offers a relaxed evening option. You can stroll around the lake for free or stop for a cold drink at one of the many bars. Live music often heard from open-air venues. Low energy required — good rest-day entertainment.
entertainment.notes_local: 长城一日游后，后海湖畔提供轻松的夜晚选择。可免费绕湖散步，或在众多酒吧之一停下来喝杯冷饮。露天场所常有现场音乐。体力消耗少，适合休息日娱乐。

entertainment.name_base: Kuanzhai Alley Night Walk (宽窄巷子夜游)
entertainment.location_base: Kuanzhai Alley, Qingyang District, Chengdu, Sichuan
entertainment.location_local: 四川省成都市青羊区宽窄巷子
entertainment.type_local: 历史巷子 / 夜间娱乐区
entertainment.note_base: Free entry; drinks and snacks available along the alleys
entertainment.note_local: 免费进入，巷子内有饮品和小吃
entertainment.notes_base: After returning from the Leshan day trip, a relaxed evening stroll through Chengdu's famous Wide and Narrow Alleys (Kuan Alley + Zhai Alley + Jing Alley). Qing Dynasty architecture, courtyard bars, tea houses, and Sichuan opera face-changing (变脸) performances at some restaurants. Good for reuniting the two travelers at a relaxed pace.
entertainment.notes_local: 从乐山一日游返回后，轻松漫步成都著名的宽窄巷子（宽巷子+窄巷子+井巷子）。清代建筑、院落酒吧、茶馆，部分餐厅有川剧变脸表演。适合两人以轻松节奏重聚。

entertainment.name_base: People's Park Matchmaking Corner (人民公园相亲角)
entertainment.location_base: People's Park, Qingyang District, Chengdu, Sichuan
entertainment.location_local: 四川省成都市青羊区人民公园内
entertainment.type_local: 文化观察 / 本地社会传统
entertainment.note_base: Free entry to park (2 CNY). Matchmaking happens on weekend mornings
entertainment.note_local: 公园门票2元，相亲角在周末上午举行
entertainment.notes_base: A uniquely Chengdu experience: parents and grandparents gather to post marriage profiles for their adult children on umbrellas and boards. Fascinating cultural observation — not a show, but genuine local social activity. Best visited on weekend mornings. May 8 is a Friday, so check if it operates weekdays too (it typically does in Chengdu).
entertainment.notes_local: 独特的成都体验：父母和祖父母聚集在一起，在雨伞和展板上张贴子女的婚恋信息。这是真实的本地社会活动，而非表演，极具文化观察价值。最佳游览时间为周末上午。5月8日为周五，相亲角工作日通常也开放。

entertainment.name_base: Sichuan Tea House Experience - Heming Teahouse (鹤鸣茶社)
entertainment.location_base: People's Park, Qingyang District, Chengdu, Sichuan
entertainment.location_local: 四川省成都市青羊区人民公园内鹤鸣茶社
entertainment.type_local: 传统茶馆 / 文化体验
entertainment.note_base: Tea from ~25-50 CNY per person; gaiwan tea service traditional style
entertainment.note_local: 茶水约25-50元/人，盖碗茶传统方式侍茶
entertainment.notes_base: Heming Teahouse inside People's Park is one of Chengdu's oldest and most authentic tea houses. Order a gaiwan (lidded bowl) tea and sit among locals playing mahjong and chess. Ear cleaners and masseuses offer services tableside. This is the quintessential laid-back Chengdu experience. Combine naturally with the matchmaking corner observation.
entertainment.notes_local: 人民公园内的鹤鸣茶社是成都最古老、最正宗的茶馆之一。点一碗盖碗茶，坐在打麻将下棋的本地人中间。有掏耳师傅和按摩师提供服务。这是成都最经典的悠闲体验，可与相亲角观察自然结合。

entertainment.name_base: Sichuan Pepper Tasting at Jinli or Local Market (花椒品鉴)
entertainment.location_base: Jinli Street or local spice market, Chengdu, Sichuan
entertainment.location_local: 四川省成都市锦里或本地香料市场
entertainment.type_local: 美食品鉴 / 文化体验
entertainment.note_base: Vendors sell sample packets of different Sichuan pepper varieties from ~10-20 CNY
entertainment.note_local: 摊贩出售不同品种花椒的小包装，约10-20元
entertainment.notes_base: Sichuan peppercorns (花椒, huā jiāo) are the defining spice of Sichuan cuisine, creating the numbing 'mala' sensation. Visit a spice market or Jinli vendors to smell and taste different varieties including red peppercorn (红花椒), green peppercorn (青花椒), and the rare vine peppercorn. A small tasting packet makes an excellent budget souvenir.
entertainment.notes_local: 花椒是四川菜的灵魂香料，带来独特的麻辣感。逛香料市场或锦里摊贩，闻一闻、尝一尝不同品种，包括红花椒、青花椒和稀有的藤椒。小包装花椒是实惠的纪念品。

entertainment.name_base: Chengdu IFS Rooftop Giant Panda Sculpture at Night (成都IFS熊猫爬楼)
entertainment.location_base: IFS International Finance Square, Jinjiang District, Chengdu
entertainment.location_local: 四川省成都市锦江区成都国际金融中心（IFS）
entertainment.type_local: 地标装置 / 夜间游览
entertainment.note_base: Free to view from street level; Chunxi Road area is nearby
entertainment.note_local: 街道免费观看，春熙路在附近
entertainment.notes_base: Matilde solo evening. The giant panda sculpture climbing up the IFS building facade is one of Chengdu's most beloved photo spots. Located in the Chunxi Road (春熙路) commercial district, this is also a great area to browse shops and have dinner. The surrounding area is lively and safe at night.
entertainment.notes_local: Matilde独自夜间活动。攀爬IFS大楼外墙的巨型熊猫雕塑是成都最受喜爱的打卡地之一。位于春熙路商业区，这里也是逛店和吃饭的好地方。周边区域夜间热闹安全。

entertainment.name_base: Muslim Quarter Evening Walk (回民街夜游)
entertainment.location_base: Beiyuanmen Muslim Quarter, Lianhu District, Xi'an, Shaanxi
entertainment.location_local: 陕西省西安市莲湖区北院门回民街
entertainment.note_base: Free to walk; street food from 5-30 CNY per item
entertainment.note_local: 免费步行，街头小吃5-30元/份
entertainment.notes_base: Arriving from Chengdu by HSR, the Muslim Quarter is a perfect first evening in Xi'an. The street is lined with Hui Muslim food stalls: roujiamo (肉夹馍, Chinese 'burger'), biangbiang noodles (biáng biáng面), lamb skewers (羊肉串), pomegranate juice (石榴汁). The Great Mosque of Xi'an is nearby. Very lively after dark.
entertainment.notes_local: 从成都坐高铁抵达后，回民街是西安第一个夜晚的完美选择。街道两旁有回民清真餐位：肉夹馍、biáng biáng面、羊肉串、石榴汁。西安大清真寺就在附近。夜晚非常热闹。

entertainment.name_base: Bell Tower Square Night View (钟楼广场夜景)
entertainment.location_base: Bell Tower Square, Beilin District, Xi'an, Shaanxi
entertainment.location_local: 陕西省西安市碑林区钟楼广场
entertainment.note_base: Exterior and square free; Bell Tower interior ticket ~45 CNY if entering
entertainment.note_local: 外观和广场免费，钟楼内部门票约45元
entertainment.notes_base: After a full day at the Terracotta Warriors and Muslim Quarter, the illuminated Bell Tower at the city center makes a beautiful evening sight from the surrounding square. The underground pedestrian shopping area (地下商业街) connects to the Drum Tower area. Good to combine with a nearby dinner.
entertainment.notes_local: 完成兵马俑和回民街的全天游览后，市中心亮灯的钟楼从广场看非常美。地下商业街连接鼓楼区域，可结合附近晚餐。

entertainment.name_base: Bell Tower and Drum Tower Night View (钟楼+鼓楼夜景)
entertainment.location_base: Bell Tower and Drum Tower, Beilin District, Xi'an, Shaanxi
entertainment.location_local: 陕西省西安市碑林区钟鼓楼广场
entertainment.type_local: 历史地标 / 夜间亮灯
entertainment.note_base: Bell Tower ticket ~45 CNY; Drum Tower ticket ~35 CNY; combo ~60 CNY. Square is free.
entertainment.note_local: 钟楼票约45元，鼓楼票约35元，联票约60元。广场免费。
entertainment.notes_base: The Bell Tower (钟楼, built 1384 Ming Dynasty) and Drum Tower (鼓楼, built 1380) are two of Xi'an's most iconic structures, dramatically lit at night. The towers mark Xi'an's historic city center. Drum Tower has evening drum performances. Viewing from the square is free and just as photogenic. Plan this before heading to the pagoda.
entertainment.notes_local: 钟楼（1384年明代建造）和鼓楼（1380年建造）是西安最具标志性的建筑，夜间灯光炫目。两楼标志着西安历史城市中心。鼓楼有晚间击鼓表演。从广场免费观看同样出片。建议在前往大雁塔前游览。

entertainment.name_base: Giant Wild Goose Pagoda Musical Fountain Show (大雁塔音乐喷泉)
entertainment.location_base: North Square of Giant Wild Goose Pagoda, Yanta District, Xi'an, Shaanxi
entertainment.location_local: 陕西省西安市雁塔区大雁塔北广场
entertainment.type_local: 免费户外表演 / 音乐喷泉
entertainment.note_base: Completely free. Show runs nightly at ~21:00; weekend shows may be extended. Arrive 20 min early for good spot.
entertainment.note_local: 完全免费。表演每晚约21:00开始，周末场次可能延长。提前20分钟到达占好位置。
entertainment.notes_base: Asia's largest musical fountain show, located at the north square of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda (大雁塔). The show features synchronized water jets up to 100m high, colored lights, and music. Show typically runs ~20 minutes. The Tang Dynasty-era pagoda is illuminated in the background. This is the unmissable free highlight of Xi'an evenings. Take Metro Line 3 to Xiaozhai Station then walk, or taxi (~15 CNY from city center).
entertainment.notes_local: 亚洲最大的音乐喷泉表演，位于大雁塔北广场。表演包括高达100米的同步水柱、彩色灯光和音乐。演出约20分钟。唐代宝塔在背景中亮灯。这是西安夜晚不可错过的免费亮点。乘地铁3号线至小寨站步行前往，或打车（市中心约15元）。

entertainment.name_base: Houhai Lakeside Final Evening Walk (后海湖畔告别夜游)
entertainment.note_base: Free to walk; optional drink at lakeside bar ~40-80 CNY
entertainment.note_local: 免费漫步，湖边酒吧可选饮品约40-80元
entertainment.notes_base: A final Beijing evening together before Matilde's departure. After the Michelin dinner, a gentle stroll along Houhai Lake with willow trees, lanterns reflected in the water, and the option of a quiet drink at a lakeside bar. Low-key but memorable farewell night in Beijing.
entertainment.notes_local: Matilde离开前与Jade共度的最后北京夜晚。米其林晚餐后，沿后海湖畔轻松散步，垂柳、灯光倒映在湖面，可在湖边酒吧小酌。低调而难忘的北京告别夜。
